title: I'm making a Darkest Dungeon meets Slay the Spire game.
author: sirmanuxgg
selftext:
**Ashmarch** is my take on a **Darkest Dungeon meets Slay the Spire**\-style game:

Turn-based combat with positioning  
Deckbuilding  
A dark post-apocalyptic world  
Character builds, upgrades and synergies  
Elites and bosses

The demo is now playable directly in the browser:

[https://sirmanux.itch.io/ashmarch](https://sirmanux.itch.io/ashmarch?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**I would really love some feedback from other game developers.**

Does the Darkest Dungeon × Slay the Spire combination work for you? Do you like the play-loop?

I have been working on the project for the last two months. It still needs a lot of polishing, balancing, etc but I am finally happy with a version that can be tested.

  
Built everything using a Claude Pro subscription in Godot 4.7. For the art I trained a custom LoRA for StableDiffusion.

  
I would love to hear your feedback and act on it. This is my first game, and I am a bit lost, honestly.

  
Thanks, everyone!

comments.author: count023
comments.body: looks a bit like vampire crawlers, the spinoff for vampire survivors that came out a few months ago.  You need to work on a more unique nagle or that's what other people will say too, "ai slop version of vampire crawlers". but you have hte bones of something good here.
